description: GDPR from the visitor's location: with no gdpr parameter, GDPR applies when the platform places the request in one of the 27 EU member states, so without a TC string nothing is stored; outside the EU, or with an explicit gdpr=0, the ID is set. Requests describe the location with Cloudflare's visitor location headers (cf-ipcountry): the Node.js target reads them because it runs with SID_TRUST_PROXY, the runner gives the Workers runtime the same values as request.cf (with isEUCountry, as Cloudflare sets it), and each stand-in passes them as its platform's own location headers.

cases.name: an EU visitor without a TC string gets no ID cookies
an EU visitor's existing ID cookies are deleted without a TC string
a visitor outside the EU gets the ID
an explicit gdpr=0 wins over an EU location
